newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Massey Ferguson sees Argentine '97 sales up 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: Massey Ferguson sees Argentine '97 sales up 40 pct.

text.p: Massey Ferguson's Argentine sales should rise by 40 percent in 1997, the company's president told a newspaper Tuesday.

"Our projections for 1997 are, as a minimum, revenue growth of 40 percent and substantial development in productivity and improving costs," Ricardo Trentini wrote in an El Cronista special supplement.
Trentini said sales should be up by 80 percent in 1996 compared to last year, buoyed by the higher grains prices which have fueled fast expansion on Argentine farms.
Massey Ferguson is a unit of of Lucasvarity Plc.
